purpose: Compare structure-preservation strategies on identical source + reference inputs. Read-only with respect to the product: nothing here changes the production engine, pricing or prompts.

defaults.userPrompt: Photorealistic architectural render. Use the reference only for its colours and surface finishes. Keep the source building, roof, openings, massing and camera angle exactly as drawn.

approaches.A: Production today: FLUX 3 edit, source + original reference image (exact production prompt and input builder, Strict mode)
approaches.B: Kontext Pro, source only, finishes supplied as a text material specification
approaches.C1: FLUX General img2img + Canny EasyControl, strength 0.60, text material specification
approaches.C2: FLUX General img2img + Canny EasyControl, strength 0.85, text material specification
approaches.CIP: PROBE: FLUX General + Canny EasyControl + IP-Adapter carrying the reference image. May be rejected by fal; a rejection is a result.
approaches.AL: Round 2: FLUX 3 edit, source + reference image, SHORT prompt (tests whether the long repeated contract suppresses realism and finish transfer)
approaches.BP: Round 2: Kontext Pro, source only, material spec + explicit structure inventory; run over 3 seeds (BP1,BP2,BP3)
approaches.CP: Round 2: FLUX General + Canny from a blank base at strength 0.95, so it must render rather than hand back the sketch

cases.title: Lakeside elevation, compatible modern reference
cases.materialSpec: Smooth off-white/light-grey rendered walls on the upper volume and the right end volume; dark-brown vertical timber cladding on the lower left volume and the terrace base; black aluminium window and door frames; black roof fascia and edge trims; warm timber-lined soffit; dusk lighting with warm glow through the glazing.
mustKeep: left service block with door and horizontal window
covered terrace with glass guardrail and right-side wing
cases.structureInventory: Two-storey flat-roofed building. Upper box: a row of eleven tall glazed panels separated by projecting black vertical fins, with a small horizontal window and a tall narrow window at its left end. Lower-left block: flat roof, vertical board cladding, a framed door, a wide two-pane horizontal window and a small square panel above the door. Centre: a full-height glazed wall with an internal staircase. Right: a flat-roofed covered terrace on slim steel posts with a glass-panel guardrail and a clad base, ending in a boxed volume with one tall window; downpipes at the posts.

cases.title: Lakeside elevation, adverse pitched-roof reference
cases.materialSpec: Bright white smooth rendered walls; black aluminium window and door frames; warm orange-brown timber door and decking tones; terracotta-red as a colour accent only on surfaces the source already has (keep every flat roof flat: never add tiles, pitches, gables or eaves); pale grey plinth; green lawn.
mustKeep: source terrace instead of a front porch
mustNeverAdd: gables or red tiled pitched roofs

cases.materialSpec: Warm cream smooth-render walls with white trim; dark grey stone-veneer cladding at the building base; black-framed windows; deep red-brown timber doors; terracotta only as a colour on surfaces the source already has (never add pitched roofs, columns, arches or balconies); grey paving and green lawn.
mustNeverAdd: columns, arched portico, balcony with railing

cases.title: Low-resolution perspective sketch (680x360), adverse reference
cases.materialSpec: Bright white smooth rendered walls; black aluminium window and door frames; warm orange-brown timber accents; terracotta-red as a colour accent only on surfaces the source already has (keep the source's flat/low roofs: never add tiles, pitches or gables); pale grey plinth; green lawn.
mustKeep: two-storey volume with cantilevered flat roof
glazed corner and vertical timber panel on the upper level
cases.structureInventory: Two-storey modern house seen from a three-quarter corner view. Upper volume with a flat cantilevered roof overhang, a large glazed corner opening with mullions and vertical timber panels beside it, and a tall blank side wall at the left. Ground floor: a deep flat canopy over a recessed glazed entrance with a few steps, a horizontal strip window at the right, and a lower glazed wing at the left. Stepping-stone path in the foreground.
